artifact.rationale: Approving. The revision resolves the single item flagged in the prior round: the source's data-retrieval block (pooch.create + load_registry_from_doi) is replaced in full by a local staged loader that keeps the same EXAMPLE_DATA.fetch interface and returns the /inputs copies verified during setup by byte size, provider-published MD5 and SHA-256, cross-checked against the cached figshare article metadata; every downstream sc.read_10x_h5 call therefore reads the original inputs unchanged, and nothing contacts the retrieval path at analysis time. Branch coverage is complete across all 35 source code cells: consolidated load (per-sample value_counts plus dimensions); mt/ribo/hb gene flags with calculate_qc_metrics(log1p=True) exported as per-cell and per-gene tables, the QC violin figure and the pct_counts_mt-colored total_counts-vs-n_genes scatter; permissive filtering (min_genes=100, min_cells=3) with post-filter dimensions; Scrublet with batch_key='sample' (per-cell doublet_score/predicted_doublet); counts-layer save with median normalize_total and log1p (both present in the final h5ad); highly_variable_genes (n_top_genes=2000, batch_key='sample') as a var table and dispersion plot; PCA with per-cell coordinates, per-gene loadings and variance ratios, the log-scale variance-ratio figure and the sample/pct_counts_mt PC panels; default neighbors with a params export and the full graph in the final object; UMAP coordinates and the sample-colored embedding; the primary Leiden (igraph flavor, n_iterations=2); both doublet/QC re-assessment UMAPs; the three additional resolutions 0.02/0.50/2.00 plotted twice exactly as the source duplicates the comparison call, with both figures exported separately; both curated marker-gene dotplots; the cell_type_lvl1 mapping; the full per-cluster Wilcoxon rank_genes_groups table; the top-5 DE dotplot; the cluster-7 top-5 extraction as a table, name list and top-gene UMAP; and the final annotated AnnData plus final obs table. Plot endpoints are preserved as rendered figures alongside their underlying transformed data (X_pca, X_umap, QC tables, variance ratios, cluster labels, the full DE table, the final h5ad), so transformations, identities and labels are retained. The diff is export-only besides that input staging: every analysis call, argument, label, marker set, mapping, figure parameter, execution order and control-flow matches the converted source exactly; the duplicate resolution-comparison cell is executed twice, as in the source; nothing is precomputed or suppressed; and setup performs no analysis (environment install with import-health reporting, verified input download, metadata and license caching only). The items below record run-time measurements for the execution stage.
scientific_changes: None in the analysis: every scanpy call and argument (qc_vars=['mt','ribo','hb'], log1p=True, min_genes=100, min_cells=3, scrublet batch_key='sample', normalize_total/log1p defaults, highly_variable_genes n_top_genes=2000 batch_key='sample', pca/neighbors/umap defaults, leiden flavor='igraph' n_iterations=2 and resolutions 0.02/0.5/2.0 with the source's key_added pattern, rank_genes_groups method='wilcoxon', the group='7' extraction, the marker_genes dict and the cell_type_lvl1 map), all figure parameters, execution order and control flow match the converted source exactly.

The single non-export change replaces the source's pooch.create + load_registry_from_doi retrieval block with a staged local loader returning the checksum-verified /inputs files; this preserves the EXAMPLE_DATA.fetch interface, the downstream sc.read_10x_h5 call sites and the input bytes, and the source contains no subsampling to preserve.

All other added code is read-only export infrastructure (_save_csv/_save_json/_save_figures helpers and per-branch export blocks appended to unchanged anchors: PCA/UMAP coordinate tables, per-gene PCA loadings, variance JSON, neighbors params with type/shape summaries, per-cell cluster labels, the full per-cluster DE table re-read from adata.uns via sc.get.rank_genes_groups_df, the cluster-7 top-5 table and gene names, the final obs CSV and the final h5ad export); none of these writes analysis state.

The exactly duplicated resolution-comparison UMAP cell is executed twice, as in the source, and captured as two separate figures via the anchored figure-capture loop; no plot is regenerated with alternative parameters.
The source's pooch import is retained in the module header and the sc.get.rank_genes_groups_df(adata, group='7').head(5) expression is kept verbatim.
